message.content: {"verdict":"sampling","cause":"TEMPERATURE_HIGH","fix":{"action":"set_param","target":"temperature","value":"0.8"},"rationale":"The request sets temperature to 3.5 and also turns off every truncation filter (top_k 0, top_p 1.0, min_p 0). That flattens the distribution across the whole vocabulary, so tokens are drawn almost at random. This matches the output: multilingual word salad in many scripts from the first token, with no attempt at a number list. A repeat_penalty of 1.3 alone would bend wording but would not produce random tokens from the start. The launch command, the template (--jinja), and the timings look normal, so the model and runtime are fine. Lower temperature to about 0.7–1.0 for creative work and restore a truncation filter such as min_p 0.05. Also consider lowering repeat_penalty to about 1.1, since 1.3 can still hurt structured output like lists."}
